# Route Mobile — Latest Quarterly Results & Full-Year Dividend

## Quarterly Results (Q4 FY26, ended March 31, 2026)

- **Consolidated revenue from operations:** ₹1,130.90 crores (audited, filed May 7, 2026) [1].  
- **Net profit (PAT) for Q4 FY26:** Not disclosed in the filing [1].  
- **Trailing twelve-month net profit margin:** 5.42% (as of latest available fundamentals) [7].

## Full‑Year Dividend (FY26)

- **Recommended total dividend:** ₹11 per equity share (face value ₹10) [1], comprising:  
  - Three interim dividends of **₹3 each** — already paid during the year.  
  - Final dividend of **₹2 per share** — proposed but **not yet approved** by shareholders; subject to approval at the ensuing AGM. No record date has been announced [1].  
- As of **June 10, 2026**, no exchange filing confirms that the AGM has been held or that shareholders have voted on the final dividend [1].

### Key Data Snapshot (as of 10 June 2026)

| Metric | Value | Source |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Share price (NSE) | ₹518.35 (–2.76%) | [6] |
| Dividend yield (trailing) | 2.25% | [7] |
| Dividend per share (trailing) | ₹12.00 | [7] |
| P/E ratio (trailing) | 13.66 | [7] |

*Note: The trailing dividend per share of ₹12.00 from fundamental data [7] includes dividends from prior periods; the FY26 recommended total is ₹11.00.*
